blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P21.69 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot has been won by a lone bettor in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026. The winning combination was 34-15-19-37-25-38, which carried a jackpot prize of ₱21,694,699.03. This was according to the PCSO results. READ: Lotto results for Oct. 29, 2026 Meanwhile, no bettor won the ₱74.93 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot. The winning combination was 44-12-20-31-35-19. The PCSO also reported no jackpot winner in the 6D Lotto draw, which produced the combination 2-5-9-0-5-6. The jackpot stood at ₱3.69 million. READ: Lotto Results Today – October 30, […]...
